text: Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Boards of Management of thirty-eight (38) Business Improvement Areas that fall within the Toronto and East York Community Council boundaries for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Baby Point Gates: Babiak, Theodore Harris, Francine Skarlatakis, Gus Stapleton, Jared Tomaszewski, Kate Tutko, Katharine Valenza, Joe The Beach: Cockfield, James Gabriele, Rick Gillespie, Marg Khosh-Ghalb, Mohammad Laforge, Lise Maida, Patrizia Pratt, Carl Bloor By The Park: Alfaro, Nelson Arcadi, James Guca, Karen Kim, Ahnan Strods, John Bloor West Village: Brown, Jennifer Carter, Bianca Cote, Wesley Klufas, Jurij Medarevic, Alexandra Sydoruk, Natalie Bloor-Yorkville: Campisi, Melissa Carman, Daniel Chruszez,…
